additional_info.subject: Issue EN
additional_info.body: The terminal has been losing OCPP communication for several years because the router has changed (ticket in progress). Without the OCPP communication, the terminal still worked perfectly. I noticed remotely that the terminal had also lost the SCB communication. When I arrived on site, the screen was frozen blue with two logos "hallo" and "hello" (see attached photo) (touch screen that does not respond), and the LEDs of the charging points were light blue (unavailable). I then rebooted locally, disconnected, arranged and reconnected the screen connectors and tried to recover the SCB communication on the Siemens router and nothing changed the situation. The terminal is well powered and visually no component appears to be damaged... The terminal is currently out of service.

additional_info.subject: Initial Analysis
additional_info.body:
The last logs are from Sept15th, 2024.
Until Sept 14th, the OCPP was offline. Once it came online, the charger started sending all the OCPP logs from June, July, and Aug to the backend.
By around 01:00 AM UTC on Sept 15th, the charger had sent logs up until Aug 12th, after which a soft reset was requested.
Since then, the charger has not come online on SCB.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0380443-DC/Si-D/FR-[NEScsD]- HMI Frozen CRM:00645000779
additional_info.body:
Hi Team,
Here is my initial analysis:
The latest logs are from Sept 15th, 2024.
Up until Sept 14th, the OCPP was offline. When it came online, the charger began sending all OCPP logs from June, July, and Aug to the backend.
By around 01:00 AM UTC on Sept 15th, the charger had sent logs up to Aug 12th, after which a soft reset was requested.
Since then, the charger has not come online on SCB.
The customer has already tried rebooting the charger, but it didn’t work.
In addition to the SCB offline issue, the charger is also experiencing an HMI freeze.
Could you please plan a site visit to address both issues?
For the HMI issue, please check all the connections to ensure they are properly secured.
For the SCB issue, please carry a spare router, a laptop with the Companion tool, and a spare tested ethernet cable.
Additionally, please bring a data-enabled SIM card, in case the current router SIM’s data plan has been exhausted due to the bulk of OCPP messages sent to SCB and the backends.
Please let us know when you can schedule a site visit.
Thank you
Best Regards,
Vishal Dhiman
eMobility Support Team
Please do not change the subject line with replying back to this email.
